scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server && tsc -p tsconfig.vercel.json
